identity.title: The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow

leadText: The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow is the second of two compilation volumes of the Pokémon Adventures released by VIZ Media. This volume contains a selection of chapters from the . As a result of this, many key events are left out. This sometimes leads to references to events that are not included in this volume. The chapters come directly from VIZ Media's first edition translation of the series.
plainText:
The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Yellow is the second of two compilation volumes of the Pokémon Adventures released by VIZ Media. This volume contains a selection of chapters from the . As a result of this, many key events are left out. This sometimes leads to references to events that are not included in this volume. The chapters come directly from VIZ Media's first edition translation of the series.

==Publications==
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: Ponyta Tale
Chapter 2: Do Do That Doduo
Chapter 3: Do Wrong, Dewgong!
Chapter 4: Cloystered
Chapter 5: Raging Rattata
Chapter 6: Pidgeotto Pick-Me-Up
Chapter 7: Extricated from Exeggutor
Chapter 8: Eradicate Raticate!
Chapter 9: Double Dragonair
Chapter 10: Rhyhorn Rising
Chapter 11: The Beedrill All and End All
Chapter 12: The Might of... Metapod?!
Chapter 13: The Legend

==Important events==
The volume consists of chapters from the . It features the two opening chapters, and Yellow's battle with Lorelei, two standalone chapters of Yellow traveling and the final battle between Yellow and Lance.

==Trivia==
No chapters from are included in this compilation.
